info.title: OpenDocs API
info.description: Publish Markdown to shareable links and export PDF/DOCX. Agents: read https://opendocs.cc/skill.md first. Send `X-OpenDocs-Client: <agent>` on every request. Errors are `{error, message, docs_url}`. Machine-readable reference for the public OpenDocs API surface used by agents, scripts, the OpenDocs CLI, and dashboard integrations.

Gone.description: The requested token or resource has expired.
